title: Dan Campbell: Alim McNeill being healthy is huge for Lions' defense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell: Alim McNeill being healthy is huge for Lions' defense
sources.description: Lions defensive tackle Alim McNeill tore his ACL in December of 2024, wasn't cleared to return until the middle of the 2025 season, and was never fully healthy last year.
